title: Tukir
description: Tukir is a dish from Timor-Leste prepared with chicken thigh, garlic, lime juice, banana leaf. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Traditional tukir is cooked inside bamboo; this uses banana-leaf parcels in the oven instead.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 45 minutes.
Place a portion of prepared filling on each leaf or wrapper, tuck in the sides and roll tightly into neat parcels.
Put the marinated chicken in clean food-safe banana-leaf parcels and roast them on a baking tray until the meat reaches 74°C; this replaces bamboo cooking.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
